🚨 Are you ready to transform an ordinary pen into a stunning Squid Game masterpiece? 🎨✨ 

In today's exciting video, I’ll guide you step-by-step in creating a jaw-dropping gonggi-themed pen that will not only elevate your stationery collection but also showcase your love for the iconic series, Squid Game! 🖊️💖

In this DIY tutorial, we'll dive into the world of creativity with super clay and a simple pen tube, turning basic materials into a vibrant, eye-catching pen. Perfect for fans of the show and craft enthusiasts alike, this project is both fun and rewarding. You'll learn how to shape colorful clay circles that represent the game's playful yet intense aesthetic and how to assemble them into a unique writing tool that you can proudly display or gift to friends.

- **Materials Needed:** I’ll provide a comprehensive list of everything you’ll need to get started on this project, ensuring you're fully equipped to dive in.

- **Tips and Tricks:** I’ll share insider tips on working with super clay, from shaping techniques to drying times, ensuring your final product looks polished and professional.
- **Personalization Options:** Feel free to get creative! I’ll suggest ways to customize your gonggi pen with different colors and designs so that you can make it truly your own.
